AC7 (all 4 web/ gates) -- re-ran `npm run type-check` (clean, tsc -b, 0 errors) and `npm run guards` (48/48) myself; TEST-DESIGNER's own handoff already quoted npm test (323/323) and npm run lint (clean) with real output, consistent with my subset re-run.
